title: WORKSHEET 32
subject: Wishes or If Only
subjectVi: Ngữ pháp bài 32: Wishes or If Only

sections.instruction: Write sentences with “I WISH” and “IF ONLY”, starting with the words given:

questions.prompt: Ayşe isn’t here. → I wish
acceptedAnswers: I wish Ayşe were here.
I wish Ayşe was here.
I wish Ayse were here.
I wish Ayse was here.
